cohort: The study included 74 Mongolian mothers and 57 Mongolian infants (57 mother-infant dyads) from herder and urban environments.
finding: The study found that maternal secretor status and lactation period significantly affected milk HMO profiles, while delivery mode was associated with infant gut microbiota profiles in infants receiving mature milk, which were characterized by bifidobacteria dominance, likely established by HMO consumption.
mod_finding: An association of infant gut microbiota profiles with delivery mode was observed among infants receiving mature milk.
cross-section timing: Samples were collected cross-sectionally from neonates receiving immature milk and infants receiving mature milk, representing different lactation stages.
